description: Feature set R. R_U = unit|contract with non-empty tests. R_manual = R \ R_U. ui:true requires design gate.

requirements.title: Detect exploitable loopback MCP-like HTTP surfaces
requirements.acceptance: Flags cors_star / no_www_authenticate_hint / known ports from fixtures

requirements.title: Probe real loopback ports when services are up
requirements.acceptance: With WorkBuddy running, scan reports open 50551 and exposure_alert

requirements.title: Attribute TCP peers on watched ports to PID/process
requirements.acceptance: Allowlist matching is pure; unknown_client classification from fixtures

requirements.title: Observe real connections to MCP ports
requirements.acceptance: Browser/PoC hitting 50551 shows activity_alert for non-allowlisted process

requirements.title: Persist alerts and scan/watch events as JSONL
requirements.acceptance: append writes valid JSON lines; creates parent dirs

requirements.title: Resident loop: scan + watch + audit on interval
requirements.acceptance: serve --once emits scan and watch; cancel flag stops loop promptly

requirements.title: Raise EXPOSURE ALERT when risk_flags non-empty
requirements.acceptance: Given a ScanReport with risk_flags, audit kind exposure_alert is written

requirements.title: Raise ACTIVITY ALERT on unknown clients
requirements.acceptance: Given WatchReport.alert_count>0, audit kind activity_alert is written

requirements.title: Hard-block unknown clients on watched ports
requirements.acceptance: PoC page cannot complete exfil while gate enabled (OS-specific)

requirements.title: Load mcp-guard.toml with scan/gate/serve/audit sections
requirements.acceptance: Missing file → defaults; invalid TOML → error

requirements.title: System tray agent: status, alerts, open audit
requirements.acceptance: Native tray reflects alerts; Open audit / Scan / Mute / Quit work on host OS

requirements.title: Derive alert snapshot from audit JSONL
Tray menu model from status + ui copy
requirements.acceptance: idle/exposure/activity + mute map to labels and ordered actions
